mismatch_summary: PRIMARY DIVERGENCE: bot get_signal (L643) and StrategySelector (L1880) omit `hour` -> S16 session filter (7-18 UTC) inert on H1 -> bot trades S16 in Asia session; backtester never does.

SECONDARY DIVERGENCE: bot StrategySelector/M15/M30 pass explicit H4 Supertrend as h4_trend; backtester uses EMA200-rising-over-4-bars proxy. Both mean 'require H4 bullish for SELL' but are not identical bar-for-bar.

why_76_live_trades_vs_15_backtest.decomposition: Missing session filter explains ~15->23 on H1 (~+50%). The rest of the gap is architectural and outside signals.py: (a) the bot's RiskGuardian exits positions early (BE / trailing-stop / early-exit) and frees the per-strategy slot to re-enter, while run_one holds one position until TP or SL; (b) S16 is reachable from BOTH the primary path and the H1 secondary loop over different bars/regimes; (c) selector routing. Net: adding `hour` will cut S16 entries ~30-45% and is necessary for bot<->backtester parity, but will NOT by itself bring the bot down to 15 - the bulk of the over-trading is position-lifecycle churn.
why_76_live_trades_vs_15_backtest.is_the_76-trade_behaviour_profitable_on_: NO. hour=OFF on H1: holdout PF 0.486 (vs 0.691 with filter), DD ~2x, live PF 0.129. hour=OFF on M30: holdout PF 0.664. Both strictly worse than the 7-18 version. Consistent with live -$163 / PF 0.88.

h4_countertrend_sell_filter.verdict: KEEP - dropping/loosening the H4 filter destroys the full-period edge (PF -> ~1.0) and worsens holdout. The H4-bullish-required-for-SELL rule is load-bearing.

verdict: NO parameter change adopted. The only is_promotable configs are either single-trade overfit artifacts (adx_gate 27/28/30 - adjacent cells collapse) or repeat a TP/SL shift (3.5->3.0 TP, 2.0->2.25 SL) that two prior sprints already validated standalone and then rejected because it degraded the real adaptive-portfolio backtest (run_adaptive_rm). S16's genuine edge is 2024->mid-2025; on the holdout it is a marginal-losing strategy at every parameterization and only becomes marginally positive (canonical WF holdout PF 1.057) via regime-gating + RiskGuardian tier scaling, not via signal params. Keep baseline params.

reconciliation_recommendation.decision: Bot MUST pass `hour` at every S16 call site (restrict to 7-18 UTC, matching the backtester). Do NOT widen or remove the session filter - the no-filter holdout is strictly worse (PF 0.691 -> 0.486, DD ~2x).

No shared constant - each loop derives it from its own bar timestamp.
reconciliation_recommendation.residual_divergence_to_flag: Bot passes explicit H4 Supertrend as h4_trend; backtester uses an EMA200-rising proxy. Both enforce 'H4 bullish required for SELL' but are not bar-identical. Options: (a) accept - the proxy is what all canonical backtests use and is slightly conservative; or (b) wire real H4 Supertrend into run_one/walk_forward_report/run_adaptive_rm. Recommend (a) for now, note for a future backtester pass.
